definitions.explanation: The general direction in which something is developing or changing.

examples.japanese: {市場|しじょう}の{動向|どうこう}を{把握|はあく}する。
{政治|せいじ}の{動向|どうこう}に{注目|ちゅうもく}する。
examples.english: To pay attention to political movements.

examples.japanese: {最新|さいしん}の{動向|どうこう}を{報告|ほうこく}する。
examples.english: To report on the latest developments.

notes:
Describes the general direction, movement, or trend of events in fields like politics, economics, markets, or society. A somewhat formal word commonly found in news and business writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {動向|どうこう}を{注視|ちゅうし}する: to closely watch developments
- {動向|どうこう}を{探|さぐ}る: to investigate trends
- {動向|どうこう}に{注目|ちゅうもく}する: to pay attention to trends
- {動向|どうこう}を{把握|はあく}する: to grasp the trend

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {市場|しじょう}{動向|どうこう}: market trends
- {業界|ぎょうかい}{動向|どうこう}: industry trends
- {政治|せいじ}{動向|どうこう}: political developments
- {最新|さいしん}の{動向|どうこう}: latest developments

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {傾向|けいこう}: tendency, inclination (more statistical/analytical)
- {趨勢|すうせい}: trend, current (formal/literary)
- トレンド: trend (loanword, more casual)
